messages:
Maya: Quick idea  food-truck hop + tiny rooftop hang this Friday? Short route from the office, a couple of taco and dessert options. Who's keen? :taco::icecream:
Ethan: Count me in. Prefer 6pm though, earlier is tight for me.
Sofia: 6pm is better for me too.
Maya: okay shifting to 6pm then.
Kai: I can bring a small portable speaker and a couple of folding stools.
Ethan: Any veg/gluten-free options?
Sofia: There's usually a vegan taco stall on 4th. I can confirm.
Maya: Thanks. If anyone wants to bring non-perishables (napkins/cutlery) that would be great.
ops-bot: Heads up: rooftop gatherings for >10 people need Facilities sign-off. Request form: https://intranet/redwood/facilities-request
Maya: Good call ops-bot, submitting now.
Kai: If rooftop doesn't happen, courtyard seating is fine as backup.
Ethan: Poll idea: "Taco Trivia" vs "Chill Playlist" vs "No Extras"  react with :taco:, :musical_note:, :fork_and_knife: to vote.
Sofia: doing :musical_note:.
Maya: :taco: for me (trivia short rounds could be fun).
Ethan: :fork_and_knife: if it ends up cramped and we just want to eat.
Maya: I'll post a short route map and pin vendors in the event.
Kai: Partners welcome? Might bring mine.
Maya: Partners welcome but rooftop cap applies. First responders on the RSVP get rooftop spots.
ops-bot: Event created on calendar: "Friday Food Hop + Rooftop" scheduled for 2024-05-17 18:00. Facilities request submitted (ID: FR-4927).
Ethan: Who wants to be cash lead for tips? I can manage.
Sofia: I'll handle napkins/cups.
Maya: Awesome. Tentative plan: meet by lobby 5:55pm, walk to trucks, grab food, rooftop for first 12, rotate if needed, else courtyard fallback. See updates here. :sun_with_face:
Kai: Sweet. See you Friday! :metal:
